question: How does admin add, update and delete shared expenses?

sections.title: Add a shared expense
sections.beforeHtml: Use this when the cost belongs to the group and should appear in the trip-level shared-expenses list.
items: Open the Trip Shared section and click Expenses.
Click Add. The Add Trip Shared Expense form opens.
Enter the required name and amount. You can also fill category and notes.
Plantour saves the shared expense and returns you to the Trip shared expenses list.

sections.title: Update a shared expense
sections.beforeHtml: Use this when the shared cost already exists and you want to correct its details.
items: Select the shared expense you want to change.
Click Update. The Edit Trip Shared Expense form opens.
Change fields such as name, amount, category, or notes.
Plantour saves the shared expense and returns you to the list.
sections.afterHtml: Shared expenses are trip-level cost entries. Assigning responsibility is handled on Trip participants through participant shared amounts and deadlines, not on individual shared-expense rows.

sections.title: Delete a shared expense
sections.beforeHtml: Use this when the trip no longer needs that shared cost entry.
items: Select the shared expense you want to remove.
Plantour removes the shared expense from that trip.
sections.afterHtml: Review the overview panel first so you understand how deleting a shared expense changes the trip-level totals, assigned amounts, and payment progress.

sections.title: Review the shared-expenses overview
items: Use the collapsible overview panel at the top of the page when you want to review trip-level shared expense totals and assignment payment progress.
The panel shows shared expenses total, assigned, accepted, rejected, paid, and waiting for payment.
Collapse the panel when you want more room for the expense list. Plantour remembers its open or closed state.
